label: Jill Valentine — Battle Suit avec P30
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE full-body static fighting-game sprite, transparent PNG.
Reference 1 is the native 2009 Resident Evil 5 Jill Valentine Battle Suit figure and determines identity, ORIGINAL costume, hair, P30 chest device, weapons and proportions. Reference 2 is the newly generated left-facing companion and determines detail density and materials. Create the matching independent RIGHT-facing three-quarter SIDE combat pose. Entire shoulders, hips, knees, boots, head and gaze oriented SCREEN RIGHT, rather than a front pose with just turned head. Place head left-of-center and both weapon muzzles to its right. Right-facing dominant silhouette, both feet grounded, athletic poised neutral guard.
Preserve adult RE5 Jill face, blonde side swept fringe and short ponytail, muted indigo-purple suit torso/shoulders/long boots, dark ribbed sleeves and thighs, dark harness and original thigh straps, gloves, centered red oval P30 and its dark fixing points. Retain original modest neckline. Keep 2 small black Skorpion VZ61s with brown grips, one naturally gripped in each hand: one aimed diagonally right at chest level, other held low pointing right. Match native weapon geometry and retain anatomical asymmetries when rotating, do not use a horizontal flip. Every finger natural, no joined weapons or hands. Calm focused adult, no firing or action impact.
Realistic richly detailed painted game-asset finish matching reference 2. Preserve exact identity and original palette, do not modernize or substitute another Jill. Only one entire character. Include complete head, ponytail, both muzzles and BOTH boots in frame with a generous empty transparent border of about 90 pixels. No cropping. True transparent RGBA background, opaque character surface, neutral lighting, no floor, pedestal, shadow, glow, fog, labels, UI, text, watermark or duplicate views. This is an independent static candidate, not animation.
